configuration: Five of the seven upstream cases of unittest/joint-friction-constraint.cpp: the constraint's construction and sparsity pattern, its Jacobian, the coupling inertia it appends to the joints, the maps between constraint forces and joint torques and between joint motions and constraint motions, and the compliance, all on the six joints supporting the right foot of a frozen 28-joint humanoid. The model is read from ic/<ic>/model.json and every operand from ic/<ic>/operands.json. constraint_empty_constructor and cast are not reproduced, and the one block that builds a default-constructed, empty constraint model is not reproduced either; see README.md.
observable: the joint dry-friction constraint: its Jacobian, the apparent joint inertia its coupling term appends, the joint torques its constraint forces map to, the constraint motions the joint motions map to, and its compliance
default_vs_upstream: upstream, except that the model and every operand are frozen rather than drawn, that the Jacobian-product helper sweeps 2 frozen right-hand sides instead of 1e4 fresh ones, which is why this check runs in milliseconds where the upstream test takes about a second, and that constraint_empty_constructor, cast and the empty-constraint-model block of the compliance case are omitted
variant: Two units in the last place, toward positive infinity, on every nonzero number of ic/nominal/model.json and ic/nominal/operands.json. Perturbing every number rather than a chosen few is deliberate and was measured on earlier leaves of this codebase: a relative change of 2.2e-16 in one component of a rotation or of a frozen vector rounds away in the last bit of an output built from all of them, and moving one component per item left dozens of observables with a spread of exactly zero. Every number still moves by exactly two units in the last place, so this remains the generic numerical-noise calibration and not a physics experiment. A number that is exactly zero is never perturbed, because two ulps above zero is a subnormal, which is a meaningless perturbation of a physical quantity and a parser hazard besides; the structural integers of the model document, njoints, nq, nv and each joint's parent index, are not numbers of that kind and are left alone. The worst measured spread is 4.4409e-16 absolute. 4 of the 21 observables show a spread of exactly zero, and they are structurally constant rather than insensitive: the constraint Jacobian, which for a joint dry-friction constraint is a selection matrix of exact zeros and ones and carries no floating-point content at all, recorded three times by three different cases, and the default compliance, which is exactly zero by construction.
altbuild: none: the same official.cpp compiled at -O0 with -ffp-contract=off against the same pinned source reproduces the -O2 -DNDEBUG result bit-identically for every graded value of this check, so an alternative build measures a floor of exactly zero and supplies no evidence. Eigen fixes the evaluation order of these expressions and the arithmetic is scalar, so the compiler has nothing to reassociate. Repeated on the worker on 2026-09-14 (x86_64, inside the env image): bit-identical.

evidence.floor_how: The same official.cpp compiled twice against the same pinned source, once at -O2 -DNDEBUG and once at -O0 -ffp-contract=off, and run on ic/nominal; every graded value was bit-identical, so the measured floor is 0.0 and the bound is set from the variant spread and the physics instead. Repeated on the worker on 2026-09-14 (x86_64, inside the env image): bit-identical.

warrant:
The graded quantities are what the joint dry-friction constraint produces: its Jacobian, which selects the active degrees of freedom; the apparent joint inertia its coupling term appends to each active joint, in kilogram metres squared; the joint torques a set of constraint forces maps to, in newton metres; the constraint motions a set of joint motions maps to; and its compliance, in metres per newton. All are in SI units and indexed by degree of freedom or by constraint row, orders the frozen model and the constraint's own active-degree-of-freedom list fix rather than the implementation.

The bound is 1e-09 absolute plus 1e-11 relative, so on the largest graded magnitude here, about 1.00e+00, it admits 1.01e-09. It is physical because every implementation fault this test can express is many orders of magnitude larger: a selection matrix that picks the wrong degree of freedom, a coupling inertia appended to the parent rather than to the joint itself, a transpose dropped from the force map, or the two maps exchanged each move individual values by between 1e-1 and 1e+0 in these units, and a relative error of one part in a thousand injected into the largest graded value lands 990,099 times over the bound. Every upstream identity also stays active: the Jacobian's rows must sum to one and be zero off the active degree of freedom, the appended inertia must equal the block of the Jacobian-weighted inertia, and each map must agree with two independent routes.

It is achievable because the arithmetic is a selection and one weighted product per degree of freedom, so a correct port differs by at most a few units in the last place, twelve decades inside the bound. Measured on this host: the two-ulp variant moves the worst of the 1,274 graded values by 4.4409e-16, using 4.404e-07 of the bound, that is 2,270,887 times of headroom, and the alternative build measured exactly zero.
